This '''Er'stacian clan''' was distinguished by the [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] worn by the [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] in its [[Army/Legends|army]]. At some point between [[22 BBY/Legends|22]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], this clan fought a [[Er'stacian clan war|war]] with [[Red-armored Er'stacian clan|their rivals]], an [[Er'stacian]] clan whose warriors wore red armor.<ref name="PP">{{Tales|13|Puzzle Peace}}.</ref><ref name="time">The events of "[[Puzzle Peace]]" must take place between 22 BBY&mdash;the year the Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor was introduced according to {{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|jediwatch/13314_1.html|New Jedi Starfighter Unveiled}}&mdash;and 19 BBY&mdash;the year Mace Windu died according to {{Film|III}}.</ref> Both sides wanted possession of the [[Venerable One]], or Megalith, a giant statue representing the primordial forebear of all Er'stacians on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Er'stacia]].<ref name="CSWE II 303">{{CSWECite|II|303|Megalith}}</ref> However, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] [[Mission to Er'stacia|arrived]] before the hostilities could escalate into an all-out genocide. When he hacked the Megalith into pieces with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], the two clans resolved their differences in order to put it back together.<ref name="PP" />
